claims.evidence: No brand, model, or part number markings are legible on the engine/transmission casing; fitment cannot be confirmed from the photo.
No test video, compression test, or dyno/run clip shown; a static photo cannot prove performance.

No shipping label, import documents, or Belgian VIN/registration visible; also conflicts with the seller's own phrase 'Direct America drive' earlier in the message, which is an internal inconsistency the photo cannot resolve.
No start-up video or sound clip provided; engine is static and disconnected in the photo, so running state cannot be confirmed.
No odometer, ECU readout, or mileage sticker visible in the photo.
No close-up of valve cover, oil pan, or torque-seal/paint markers to confirm the unit hasn't been disassembled; bolts shown are generic mounting bolts, not seal evidence.

risks.risk: Engine/transmission may not actually fit the claimed GMC Sierra V8 2008-2015 models (no part number visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of casting number, engine block stamp, or transmission tag/VIN sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified-fitment generic used engine/transmission core, not as a guaranteed-fit part.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (pistons, valves, gear wear) is unknown; 'no knock, tested' is an unverified claim.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/idling with audible sound, plus compression test readout.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-running/untested worst case, i.e. as a core unit only.

risks.risk: Possible accident or flood damage not disclosed (reason for removal unknown).
risks.proof: Photos of the donor vehicle or wreck, or a clear shot of the engine bay it was pulled from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible hidden damage, discounted accordingly.

risks.risk: Mileage claim ('low mileage') cannot be confirmed; could be high-mileage or tampered.
risks.proof: Photo/video of odometer or diagnostic scan showing mileage history.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (sensors, ECU, wiring harness, mounts) is uncertain; missing parts add cost for buyer.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set showing all sides including connector ends and sensor ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete unit requiring additional parts.

risks.risk: Leaks, cracks, or corrosion on hidden sides (bottom, rear) not visible from the single angle shown.
risks.proof: Additional photos/video from underside, rear bell-housing, and oil pan area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible leak/crack damage until shown otherwise.

risks.risk: Origin claim (Belgium vs 'America drive') is internally inconsistent, raising provenance/import-duty and fraud-adjacent doubts.
risks.proof: Import/customs paperwork or shipping documents matching a single consistent origin.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverifiable origin, not given any Tokunbo/import premium.

proof_requests: Close-up of engine block casting number and transmission ID tag
Video of the engine starting and idling with sound
Photo of odometer or scan tool mileage readout if available separately
Additional photos from underside, rear bell-housing, and oil pan showing no leaks/cracks
Any import/shipping documents clarifying country of origin
Photos of all connector ends and sensor/accessory completeness
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used engine-with-transmission core, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, untested, unknown mileage, possible hidden damage) pending the listed proofs that could raise the price.
